application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a rear roof extension; and erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side of the existing back addition.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: Render finish to the extension, with a soldier-course brick detail above the new external rear opening to the garden.

- Roof extension: Grey roof tiles to match the existing roof in colour, profile and finish.

- Dormer facing materials: Zinc cladding.

- Windows and doors: Aluminium, colour to match the existing dwelling.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).


Notes:
Look out for different brick colour/if they are proposing different mortar bonding/different material entirely.  The text in red is just a guide for commonly used materials so you need to edit to reflect what is being approved.

If very specific window details are needed may need to be a separate condition.

If different materials for different windows/elevations specify the floor/elevation to which these details relate.

Condition : 4 - No part of any roof of the extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs.

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roof of the extension hereby permitted.
												
It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment received 15.05.2026. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.  

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
